**Coaching Note:**
When the enemy king is trapped in the corner with limited escape squares, look for forcing checks that create threats to other pieces. Here, Rg7+ drives the king to h8, then Rg8+ is a royal fork—checking the king while attacking the undefended rook. After the forced Kh7, you simply capture the rook, winning the exchange decisively. Always scan for pieces that become vulnerable when the king moves to a constrained square.
